confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Guangzhou price levels for July 2026. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and bar anchors vary more by district, star rating and season, so their ranges are wider.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large mainland Chinese tier-1 cities, mainly Shenzhen for dining and everyday prices, with hotel anchors set slightly below Shanghai and Beijing. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship because direct knowledge of bar pricing is weaker.
